authorSelfScore.scorer: author self-score (the authoring agent; not the independent score create-rigged-character-assets requires)
gaps: The front grille and chimney mouths read pale peach in the engine (front grille about sRGB 208, 164, 127) where the sheet shows saturated amber-orange: three.js AgX tone mapping desaturates F08C2C emission, and GLOW_STRENGTH is held at 1.0 (above the 0.7 convention) as a compromise.
The fists read as a row of four finger tubes from the front, a little comb-like; the sheet's fists are rounder, heavier mitts with a broad back of hand.
The head is smaller than the sheet's and partly hidden behind the top hoop from a low seated eye line; the side view shows no distinct face plate.
The legs (gunmetal thighs, brass greaves and sabatons) are slimmer and shorter-looking than the sheet's chunky armoured legs.
The arms hang close to vertical from the side; the sheet angles the forearms forward more strongly.
The walnut and brass are factor-only (no wood grain, plank wear or brass engraving textures); the barrel stays slightly lighter and warmer than the sheet's walnut in direct light.
The back reads as a walnut barrel with a small glowing grille and pleats; the sheet's back detailing (straps, vent plate) is simplified.
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score from bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg: orthographic EEVEE renders (AgX, the fixed shared light rig, not tuned to the score) of the low-poly model at the concept sheet's front, side and back angles, framed at the sheet's own scale (2.1 m over 806 sheet pixels), judged side by side against the sheet crops, plus the five in-engine clip shots in staging/engine (three.js 0.186.1, headless Chromium launched with ANGLE Metal GPU flags; the WebGL renderer string was not retained, so the backend is unconfirmed). This pass rebuilt the body from the independent review's list: rounded layered brass pauldrons with emerald bosses as the widest shape at the shoulder line, gunmetal upper arms, big smooth brass cylinder forearms, huge brass fists hanging forward of the body near knee height, a six-pleat walnut bellows with a brass belt, emissive front and back grilles and chimney mouths (golem-glow), emerald inlays at shoulders, elbows and knees from COLOR_0, walnut staves and pleats instead of black rings, and smooth-shaded brass. Walnut colour was matched by sampling the engine idle shot: the barrel reads about sRGB (105, 68, 44) lit and (71, 45, 32) in shadow against the concept's about (84, 53, 34); the previous build measured about (140, 93, 64).

rubric.note: The base idea is there: a barrel torso on short legs, two chimneys and a small domed head. The design calls it the broadest shape in the roster because of massive pauldrons, long gorilla arms and cylinder forearms ending in huge round fists at knee height. The model has sphere shoulders, thin stick upper arms, faceted cuffs ending at the hip and small dark ball fists in brass claws. The lower body is a faceted brass bucket rather than a pleated bellows, and the overall width falls short of the concept.

Present: the barrel with vertical brass straps and a round chest grille, the two chimneys, and round eyes (the documented deviation). Missing or wrong: the bellows pleats are black rings rather than walnut pleats, and the huge fists are absent. The chest grille does not glow even though a golem-glow material exists (the grille samples pale tan, about sRGB 196, 157, 118). There are no emerald inlays, no back grille, and the chimney mouths have only thin peach rims.

The walnut grain on the barrel reads well. The brass parts are low-segment prisms with flat-shaded facets, and in the engine a blown-out white facet stripe runs down each forearm. The feet are plain trapezoid blocks.

The barrel walnut measures about sRGB 140, 93, 64 in the engine idle shot, against about 84, 53, 34 in the concept and the art bible's oiled walnut #583C26. That is roughly 1.6x too light and reads pinkish. The model has no emerald and no amber focal light.
At 2.6 m it reads as a distinct barrel robot and the raised-fist attack pose reads. It has no focal light, and the small fists and arms do not read as a heavy crusher.

topFixes: Rebuild the arms to the concept: layered pauldrons, long arms, large smooth-shaded cylinder forearms and huge rounded brass fists hanging to knee height.
Use golem-glow on the front and back chest grilles and the chimney mouths so the core reads as the focal light, and add the emerald shoulder, elbow and knee inlays through COLOR_0.
Darken the walnut to the art-bible value. Replace the black rings with walnut or leather bellows pleats, and smooth-shade the faceted brass.
independentScore.method: independent visual review against assets-source/concepts/golem-sheet-1.png by a separate reviewer agent. No fidelity-compare sheet exists, so the concept sheet was judged at native resolution directly against the low front, side and 3/4 Blender renders, the owner review sheet and the five in-engine clip shots (seated player, 2.6 m), with a 2x crop of the idle shot. Walnut value was measured as the median sRGB of barrel patches. Rubric: silhouette and proportions 30, signature features 25, surface detail and material read 20, colour and value 15, readability at play distance in the engine shots 10.
